usage: Flutter widget ports of the best patterns. Self-contained with previews.

dart_widgets.title: Evidence-Log Chat Rows
dart_widgets.description: Nordic-noir incident chat rows with a timestamp evidence gutter; hard facts, no comfort bubbles.

dart_widgets.title: Brutalist Deploy CTA
dart_widgets.description: Industrial-brutalist deploy CTA for Rivet CI: giant stacked Anton headline, safety-orange install button, install one-liner.

dart_widgets.title: De Stijl Bento
dart_widgets.description: Asymmetric de-stijl bento for Signalbox: one large red block, two offset blocks. Never three equal cards.

dart_widgets.title: Editorial Hero
dart_widgets.description: Offset editorial hero for Ledgerline: hairline masthead, oversized Fraunces headline, rule-framed facts strip. No template hero.

dart_widgets.title: Night-Train Split Login
dart_widgets.description: Midnight-railway split login for Nightline: brass departures board beside the sign-in form; timetables set with confidence.

dart_widgets.title: Neo-Brutalist Onboarding Wizard
dart_widgets.description: Sticker-style onboarding wizard for Sprout kids' savings: thick borders, hard shadows, block progress indicator.

dart_widgets.title: Honest Pricing Table
dart_widgets.description: Swiss-rational brutal pricing table for Paperstack: two asymmetric tiers with an honest-math footnote, no card grid.

dart_widgets.title: Docs-Style Settings Page
dart_widgets.description: Warm documentation-style settings for Margin notes: numbered sections, hairline dividers, mono margin notes.

dart_widgets.title: Terminal Stats Panel
dart_widgets.description: Phosphor-green terminal stats readout for Nightjar: dotted leader lines, amber warning line, block cursor.

dart_widgets.title: Zine Testimonial Wall
dart_widgets.description: Risograph zine testimonial cards with misregistered accent shadows, catalog numbers, and staggered indents. No card grid.
